limitations: This is visual transcription and translation verification, not an independent proof of every theorem or exercise.

assurance: Every PDF page 58–97 was personally visually inspected by this independent reviewer, and every saved mathematical expression in EN/ZH was compared to the original. This is an audit of correspondence to source, with explicitly documented source corrections; it is not a guarantee of mathematical infallibility.
